description: This file defines the ShortcutHelper class, which manages app shortcuts in an Android application. It handles creating, updating, restoring, and pinning shortcuts, as well as fetching favicons for URLs. The class interacts with Android's ShortcutManager and provides utility methods for shortcut manipulation.

classes.name: ShortcutHelper
classes.description: A helper class for managing and manipulating application shortcuts, including creation, refresh, pinning, enabling/disabling, and fetching favicons.

methods.name: ShortcutHelper
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the ShortcutHelper with the application context.

methods.name: maybeRestoreAllDynamicShortcuts
methods.description: Checks if dynamic shortcuts are empty and can restore or set default shortcuts.

methods.name: reportShortcutUsed
methods.description: Reports usage of a shortcut by ID.

methods.name: callShortcutManager
methods.description: Executes a shortcut manager operation with error handling.

methods.name: getShortcuts
methods.description: Returns all shortcuts related to the app, including manifest, dynamic, and pinned.

methods.name: refreshShortcuts
methods.description: Refreshes shortcut data if stale or forced, updating their last refresh time.

methods.name: createShortcutForUrl
methods.description: Builds a ShortcutInfo object for a given URL.

methods.name: setSiteInformation
methods.description: Sets site-specific info like title, label, and favicon for a shortcut.

methods.name: setExtras
methods.description: Adds refresh timestamp info to shortcut extras.

methods.name: normalizeUrl
methods.description: Ensures the URL has http or https prefix.

methods.name: addWebSiteShortcut
methods.description: Adds a new shortcut for a website, optionally requesting it to be pinned.

methods.name: removeShortcut
methods.description: Removes a shortcut from dynamic shortcuts.

methods.name: requestPinShortcut
methods.description: Requests to pin a shortcut, providing an intent sender.

methods.name: fetchFavicon
methods.description: Downloads the favicon icon from a URL.
